content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Dayton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's formal requirements and document your project roles, responsibilities, and hours before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our Dayton-focused instructors deliver the PMI-required contact hours through interactive sessions you can attend from home or office, with flexible scheduling to fit your work calendar.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI, document your project-management experience, and submit your formal application along with the required examination fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner and sit for the PMP certification exam when you feel confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle through project work, training, and community involvement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU-eligible courses to support your continued professional development and credential renewal.
